title: Evaluation request
description: Request to evaluate one pinned pattern revision for an optional size, measurement profile and material/fit configuration (design decisions ADR-006, ADR-011 §3, ADR-017). Every input is a pinned artifact reference; individual measurement values are never inlined but referenced, and each reference is authorized individually by the implementation. Conditions enforced by this schema: 'sizeKey' requires 'sizeSystemRef'; 'requestedOutputs' containing 'validation-report' requires 'validationProfile'; containing 'fit-evaluation-report' requires 'fitProfileRef' and 'garmentMeasurementSpecRef'.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of an evaluation request.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

evaluatorProfile.description: Evaluator profile to use. Informative: evaluator profiles are identified by ID and version only and are not digested in 1.0.

gradingRuleSetRef.description: Pinned grading rule set. When present, its measurement-source rules decide where each measurement input of the pattern takes its value from.

bodyMeasurementProfileRef.description: Pinned body measurement profile used when no size entry provides a value for a measurement input.

fitProfileRef.description: Pinned fit profile. Required when 'requestedOutputs' contains 'fit-evaluation-report'.

garmentMeasurementSpecRef.description: Pinned garment measurement specification whose targets define the 'measurement-report' entries. Required when 'requestedOutputs' contains 'fit-evaluation-report'.

sizeKey.description: Size to evaluate, resolved only together with 'sizeSystemRef' (a size label alone is never a reference).

configurationKey.description: Key naming the material/fit configuration of this request. Inside fixtures it is declared by the fixture manifest's 'configurations'.

materialAssumptions.description: Inline material assumptions for this evaluation (declared, not tested).

toleranceProfile.description: Tolerance profile (ID and version) used to judge the results.

validationProfile.description: Validation profile (ID and version) for the requested validation report. Required when 'requestedOutputs' contains 'validation-report'.

requestedOutputs.description: Outputs the evaluation is asked to produce, as a set.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself (digest profile d2p-digest-v1).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

requestedOutput.title: Requested output
requestedOutput.description: One output kind an evaluation request can ask for: 'geometry-snapshot' (a geometry snapshot, always produced on success), 'measurement-report' (the evaluation's 'measurements' entries for the applicable garment measurement targets), 'fit-evaluation-report' (a fit evaluation report referencing the evaluation) or 'validation-report' (a validation report against 'validationProfile').
